text:
sam: Quick note from today's latency triage: compactor starting right after a short prefetch is causing surprising IO churn and p99 blips. Thinking we need a "slab handshake" between prefetcher and compactor.

nina: What do you mean by handshake?

sam: Two cheap primitives: 1) lease_stamp per slab (write-on-access timestamp, atomic), 2) compactor checks stamp and skips slabs touched within lease_ms. No heavy locks.

rafi: That avoids compaction ejecting freshly-prefetched pages. But what about long compactions that need to make progress?

sam: Add a preemptible compaction token: compactor acquires token(want_ms, tenant, priority) and must heartbeat. If token revoked (due to active leases or credit exhaustion) it flushes a chunk-progress marker and yields. Resume later.

claire: Chunking is key. Suggest chunk size adapt based on recent preempt rate: more preempts -> smaller chunks. Also record chunk boundary atomically so resume is idempotent.

nina: Prefetch side: expose a small hint on requests: prefetch_hint: "none|small|full". Small -> do probabilistic prefix prefetch (top K spans). Avoid aggressive pulls for sub-150ms requests.

rafi: Telemetry we need: slab_lease_writes, compaction_token_acquired, compaction_token_revoked, compaction_chunks_completed, prefetch_evicted_after_prefetch_ms, small_request_p95/p99_by_tenant. That will let us tune lease_ms and chunk sizes.

sam: Also propose a pool-level fairness token so one tenant's compactions don't monopolize compactor resources. Pool tokens refill at pool_rate and are consumed proportionally to tenant weight.

claire: Edge: ensure lease_stamp cheap. Use a single atomic 64-bit epoch per slab and write current epoch on access. If it's cost-prohibitive on hot path, sample writes (1/16) and accept some false negatives.

nina: Rollout plan: behind FF -> canary 2% tenants with verbose metrics -> 10% -> enable adaptive chunk sizing for small cohort -> full. Kill-switch to disable handshake and revert.

infra-bot: created /infra/checks/slab-handshake-1911112222 4cb 5 checks pending

sam: I'll draft a short RFC with API sketches (lease_stamp API, compaction_token API, prefetch_hint) and a microbench: 100ms bursts every 400ms vs steady load.

rafi: I'll prototype the token/heartbeat prototype and a tiny in-memory sim to validate fairness and resume semantics.

claire: I'll add unit tests for mid-chunk abort/resume and a scenario with aggressive prefetch followed by immediate compaction to catch races.

sam: Thanks all. If perf shows p99 improvement with modest compaction overhead, we'll ship.
